# Sonic branding and jingles

**A sonic logo, stings and a recurring audio signature: brief, motif, AI generation, rights, loudness, an asset kit and where to use it.**

Builds a sonic identity for a creator, character or agent — a 1–3 second sonic logo, intro and outro stings, a notification sound and a loopable bed — from a sonic brief and a hummable motif, with AI music and sound-effect generation through @useclaudia/media, licensing and ownership checks (tool terms, human authorship, sound marks), loudness targets per destination, an asset kit and a placement map. Use when someone wants a jingle, sonic logo, audio signature, intro sting, podcast intro, stream alert sound, or a recurring sound for Claudia or their own character.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 2–3 h for a first kit | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Write the sonic brief
2. Design the motif before generating
3. Generate candidates with AI
4. Pick and refine by ear
5. Clear the rights
6. Master for each destination
7. Build the asset kit
8. Place it the same way every time
9. Label and log

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/sonic-branding-and-jingles.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/sonic-branding-and-jingles.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/sonic-branding-and-jingles.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/sonic-branding-and-jingles.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill sonic-branding-and-jingles`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `sonic-branding-and-jingles.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/sonic-branding-and-jingles`.
